parent_objective: design pair/group objective after M1340 classifies two-condition directional conflict
blocked_by: M1340 shows rowwise M1339 exact objective has balanced one-sided two-condition conflict
supersedes: direct rowwise source-history objective update from M1339

public_gates: M1341 must not update actor weights
M1341 must not use private holdout
M1341 must preserve actor input contract
M1341 must design group-level objective semantics
M1341 must preserve both condition rows inside each group
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use pair-specific tuning to hide conflict

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a group-level objective for the M1340 two-condition directional conflict
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process design only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, actor-update, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design optimizes one condition row independently of its paired row
stop if design uses pair-specific overfit weights
stop if design routes directly to PPO
fallback_plan: if pair-group objective is well specified, route to no-update exact evaluator for group metrics
if group semantics are ambiguous, route to group-corpus audit
if source-current projection is the blocker, route to evaluator projection repair
if objective is not actionable, synthesize branch before update work
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1340 routes finite rowwise conflict to group-level objective design

admission_evidence: PPO and actor update remain blocked
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: group-min or lexicographic objective terms are specified
condition-balance and anti-overfit guards are specified
next implementation or audit route is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1341 designs objectives over zero-context source-current diagnostics and cannot claim closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design group-level correct-history versus wrong-history residuals that require both condition rows to improve
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If group-level objectives are underdetermined, route to source-current projection or corpus repair before actor update.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: The M1340 two-condition conflict can be addressed by designing a group-level objective that treats source_identity/probe_template pairs as the unit of work before any actor update.
success_criteria: design specifies group keys and expected group counts
design specifies group-min or lexicographic directional terms
design specifies anti-overfit guards against solving one condition only
design specifies exact no-update group evaluator or bounded implementation route
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design routes directly to PPO or actor update
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1341 passes as a design milestone if it specifies group-level objective semantics and anti-overfit guards for the two-condition directional conflict without training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, or actor-input expansion.
